annotations.text:
GETTING OUT OF THE NIGHT

The only door is a one-second hold inside the admin drawer, and it says what it costs: counting starts, no rebuys.

Count up is where the money stops being live. Everything after it reads figures it did not set.

CLOSING IT

Three steps by the app's own counter, and the middle one is skipped entirely when the night does not balance.

Close the session is the point of no return: after it the rounding step is locked and the night is a record.

AFTERWARDS

Read back weeks later by somebody who cannot ask the host — which is why the settled row carries its own arithmetic under the name.

Every phone here is a photograph, not a redrawing: scripts/ui-shots.mjs plays the canonical night through the built app and writes the PNGs beside this board.

So a figure that looks wrong on this board is wrong in the app.
